tokens.name: quantum-blue
tokens.usage: Primary qubit state, coherent superposition. Used as background on `body::before`, `body::after`, `.status-badge`; border on `.status-pill.running`.

tokens.name: quantum-blue-light
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.card-badge`, `.job-id`, `.status-pill.running`. 4.3:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: entanglement-purple
tokens.usage: Quantum entanglement, non-local correlation. Used as background on `body::before`, `body::after`, `.stat-icon.entangle`.

tokens.name: cold-white
tokens.usage: Absolute zero environment, cryogenic precision. Used as text on `body`, `.card-title`, `.quantum-gate`. 18.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: border-quantum
tokens.usage: Primary qubit state, coherent superposition. Used as background on `body::before`, `body::after`, `.status-badge`; border on `.status-pill.running`.

tokens.name: border-entangle
tokens.usage: Quantum entanglement, non-local correlation. Used as background on `body::before`, `body::after`, `.stat-icon.entangle`.

tokens.name: success-green
tokens.usage: Successful gate operations, high fidelity. Used as shadow/glow on `.status-indicator`; text on `.stat-trend.up`, `.status-pill.completed`. 7.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: error-red
tokens.usage: Error states, quantum noise, phase collapse. Used as text on `.stat-trend.down`, `.status-pill.failed`. 5.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: category-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 19.3:1 on `page-bg`.
